headline: Anil Kataria files substantial acquisition disclosure for D. P. Abhushan Limited under SEBI takeover code
sum: Anil Kataria has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in D. P. Abhushan Limited, triggering mandatory takeover code compliance and transparency requirements under SEBI's 2011 Takeover Regulations.
detail: The disclosure was submitted by Anil Kataria to NSE in compliance with Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure within 30 days of crossing specified shareholding thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%). The filing indicates a material acquisition event but does not yet confirm the acquisition value, exact shareholding percentage, or whether an open offer will follow. The next stage typically involves either a formal open offer (if threshold-crossing occurred) or submission of an exemption claim if applicable.
